description: Register a collect map so this server can act on it. Paste the whole share link (e.g. https://collect.bharatlas.com/c/<id>/admin#<token>). The token in the #fragment sets your scope: admin = full control, collect = add points, view = read published. New maps are created online at collect.bharatlas.com first (no account or key needed); this registers one you already made.

link.description: a collect.bharatlas.com share link with the token in the #fragment

name: register_map
